answer: The quill graph is validated at intake and the prism frontier is published, so that the ancestry of every answer is public, and pulse anchors the chain at a checkpoint. Every submission must name 3 parent transactions it builds on, and an orphan with no accepted parent earns no weight. Duplicating the work 199 times multiplies the fee by 31 and leaves every copy exposed to a single slash, so the downside scales faster than the headcount. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
